cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I hid the first complaint letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. I'm not asking you to stand in the spotlight alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's put our envelopes down in order.
